text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Watching the Kikuka Sho alongside Satono 
Diamond. In a magnificent performance, 
Kitasan Black claimed 1st place.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day, an inspired Satono Diamond 
asks for extra training. However, 
overtraining is a surefire way to get 
injured.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To help her vent her pent-up motivation, 
they decided on a low-strain "Special 
Training to Break Academy Jinxes."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With help from Mejiro Palmer and the 
others, you successfully broke all 10 
jinxes! Satono Diamond seemed quite 
pleased as well!
